findings.detail: The two reserved close slots were taken by duplicated prior-week ETF-flow stories. The eligible comprehensive September 28 KRX close story with investor-group flows and broader session context was absent from the writer input. The visible post consequently says institution and retail flows were not provided, although an eligible pre-cutoff original contained them.

The revised ETF flow paragraph expressed the magnitude of a negative source figure as a positive amount followed by '순유출'. Current numeric matching rejected it by sign even though that wording describes the same outflow. The accepted final post therefore omits the September 18-23 fund-flow rotation.

The revised rates/metals paragraph gave the sourced US ten-year +20bp and two-year +10bp September 23-25 moves, the 05:40 ET gold spot decline and separately timed silver spot decline. The current direction checker does not recognize 'off by' and 'shed'; it rejected the paragraph. The 'second quarter' to Korean '2분기' mapping also failed, removing the central-bank gold-purchase counterpoint. The visible main post stresses rates without quantifying the move.

KOSPI 6,889.74 (-2.70%) and KOSDAQ 846.58 (+0.25%) agree with the qdata public-API readback of a stable object whose last_modified predates cutoff. The object was read the next morning, so it was not a frozen live edition observation.

The visible post distinguishes the 15:30 dollar/won reference, prior-period US market background, premarket oil quotes, planned versus implemented tariff cuts, and a customer-reported Qatar LNG extension. It does not present the cited holiday-conflicting older FX trading dates as verified sessions.

overall: The main post is readable and factually restrained in many places, but the missing full close/flow context and rejected rates, metals, and ETF rotation are material. The model review also returned reduce. This is a genuine frozen-case failure, not a publication pass or a five-day live qualification.
